findings.problem: The hint rules out disculpa but not the other common one-word verb apologies perdona, perdone and disculpe, so a learner could reasonably give one of those.
findings.fix: hint: one-word apology, not a verb form like perdona or disculpa, and not lo siento

note: The interjection "sorry" is clearly separate from the other card's noun "forgiveness" (el perdón), so the two cards don't clash.
